last.verdict: Record quarter, but softer interest-income growth and trimmed targets sent shares lower.

reasons.label: Guidance toward low end
reasons.text: Full-year revenue growth and margin gains now expected near the low end of ranges.

reasons.label: Slowing interest income
reasons.text: Net interest revenue rose 14% to $3.48B, the slowest growth in recent quarters.

reasons.label: Revenue just short
reasons.text: Revenue of $7.17B was a touch under the roughly $7.2B expected, despite 17% growth.

story: Schwab has posted record results several quarters running, with interest income growth cooling from 37% a year ago to 14% now. Stock has repeatedly slipped on the news; one analyst calls this the third straight quarter of a record report followed by a decline.
